title: [Decision] The list bulk bar offers only delete: should the platform offer bulk edit?
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「等我决定的都要立卡，并且从业务的角度给我具体解释和我沟通」 (2026-11-04). Measured by the seat on `main` `63b86b385d`, on the example CRM unless noted. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## The question

A sales manager reassigns 40 leads when someone leaves, or moves a batch of deals to a new close date. The bulk bar offers 删除 and nothing else. An author can declare `bulkActions` per view, but that takes a package change, and each app must build it again.

Governing text: `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:3577` (`bulkActions`) and the `bulk` API operation (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:53`). No ADR rules on a generic bulk edit.

## Measured

Selecting one row on 商机 shows 已选择 1 项, 删除, 清除. The example app declares no `bulkActions`.

## Options

- **A. A generic 批量修改** for fields the reader may edit and the object allows, running each row through validation, with a per-row result.
- **B. Bulk owner change only,** the most common case.
- **C. Leave it to `bulkActions`.**

## Recommendation: B first, then decide on A

## 四轴分析

**实际业务需求。** 离职交接和区域调整时最集中，频率不算天天有，但一次就是几十上百条。今天只能逐条改或导出再导入，代价很高，也容易错。

**项目长远合理性。** 长远看 A 才是完整能力，但要先定：部分失败怎么呈现、状态机和审批怎么走、审计怎么记。B 把这些问题缩到一个字段先走通，不会白做。

**防 AI 写错。** 走现有校验和权限，不新增元数据。必须逐条校验，不能为了快绕过规则。

**创业阶段不扩散。** B 范围小、价值高。A 现在做范围偏大。

| 棱 | A | B | C |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 业务 | 强 | 强 | 弱 |
| 长远 | 强 | 中 | 中 |
| 防错 | 中 | 中 | 强 |
| 不扩散 | 弱 | 强 | 强 |

## Not measured

Whether ownership transfer already has a bulk server path. The transfer gate exists per ADR-0142; a bulk route was not read.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "bulkActions: z.array" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`
